scope: Physical Android uninterrupted larger-Wikipedia title-query/first-result/top-of-article activity; four sessions, two ordered pairs, not a causal optimization experiment or general performance certification.

artifact.scope: Controlled test artifact; five reviewed PDF/preview overlays were uncommitted at measurement. Not release acceptance.

workload.selection: First displayed title-query result. Computer resolves through the observed .computer result to List of Internet top-level domains; Mathematics resolves to Exponentiation.
workload.viewing: Reference readiness, two-second top-of-article dwell, reference readiness; no vertical scrolling or full-article reading.
workload.checkpointZero: After archive selection and Animal warmup, not untouched cold-start memory.
workload.additionalNavigation: Animal preparation plus Animal return searches after cycles5,10,20 are additional to the20 counted primary cycles.
workload.searchFlow: Ours submits Enter; official uses displayed title suggestions. Matched user workload, not identical backend request counts or latency measurement.
workload.appearance: Original reader appearance; default app font/text sizes and chrome; canvas geometry differs.

referenceAdmission.scope: Both contact sheets inspected; queries open the first displayed result, not necessarily an exact-title match. All20 actual article headings match across apps.
referenceAdmission.observedComputerFirstResult: .computer redirects to List of Internet top-level domains; directly observed in scoped title-search UI.

rejectedPreparation.reason: Preparation without the four-second startup dwell selected the smaller Wikipedia100 Animal article; the large-archive reference gate rejected the run before checkpoint zero. No admitted samples or completed primary cycles.

interpretation: Both matched pairs end lower for ours:321.7173 vs404.1523MiB and318.6563 vs385.2715MiB; differences-82.4351/-66.6152MiB.
Growth from own prepared checkpoint zero is67.0020/64.4824MiB ours versus131.7188/125.6299MiB official; excess growth-64.7168/-61.1475MiB favors ours in both pairs.
Our memory still grows: cycle5to20 adds15.7866/23.2168MiB. These observations do not establish fixed overhead, a plateau, absence of a leak, peak memory or unbounded-session behavior.

Our renderer PSS rises58.6870/57.0957MiB from0to20. Official main-process PSS rises133.7754/112.1338MiB and native-heap PSS rises112.6992/112.7871MiB. PSS categories are not retained-heap attribution or additive causal explanations.

All64samples retained; allsessions20primarycycles, continuous recordedmain/renderer generations, unchangedinstalledAPKidentities and completed stopboth/Home cleanup. Four adjacent samples per checkpoint are not four independent sessions.

The prior wrong-archive preparation supplied no admitted sample and remains excluded. Reference filenames retaining UNVERIFIED are historical; parent visual admission and original PNG hashes are recorded separately.

Same frozen APKs as cold-reader and map studies; no source optimization was made between these sessions. Whole-app advantage is limited to this workload, not causally attributed to an individual change.

deviceSettingCleanup.officialAllFilesAccess: Restored through the observed Android Settings switch to OFF; read-only appops inspection confirmed UID MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE deny and default package mode, matching pre-study state. Launcher foreground afterwards.
